additional_info.subject: ID0460598-DC/Si-D/OM-[Y2/RD300000005010] Emergency Alert Shutdown Error CRM:03098000184
additional_info.body:
Hello Maria, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
My name is Francisco and I'm part of the Experts team.
From our previous tickets I have the following information:
And
My first question is, what was done? Nothing was ever shared with us, we propose troubleshooting steps but get no feedback.
I checked the charger and find that it's going offline due to the extreme temperature inside the charger.
Here is a small guide of troubleshooting steps to take:
The idea is to remove the cables from the KF6 and measure ohms in the cables, when we error is live.
Next thing, XD10.1 is a connector that gets loose, so it's a good idea to go there and make sure it's connected properly from the inside and outside. here is an example of a similar issue we found in another region:
If the measurement is not correct, then please replace the BT4. If the problem persists even after HW change, then it must be related to the hot weather of the country.
Let me know your feedback before I send the ticket to the queue for on-site support.
Thanks a lot and have a nice week ahead.
Best regards,
Francisco
